title: ✅ Vercel earns a global AI management certification.. the first of its kind!
body: ✅ Vercel earns a global AI management certification.. the first of its kind!

Vercel announced on November 20 that it has completed the ISO 42001:2023 certification, the international standard for AI management systems, after an independent audit by an accredited certification body.

The certification covers the company's core infrastructure and its main AI products, including the AI Gateway, the Vercel Agent and the v0 interface-building tool, as well as open-source AI-powered frameworks, and the people and processes that build and operate these products.

The certification came after a two-stage audit by an independent accredited body, which examined governance controls across the hosting infrastructure, employees and generative products, including leadership responsibility, AI risk assessment, lifecycle management, data governance, transparency and continuous improvement.

The certification is valid for three years, with annual surveillance audits to confirm continued compliance as products evolve, and enterprise customers can view the certificate and audit documents through the company's Trust Center.

The company says it is the first to complete this certification, at a time when enterprise demand is growing for assurance that the AI platforms they rely on are managed according to internationally recognized standards, not just marketing promises.
Simply put: an international certificate proves that AI products are managed by clear rules.. so do such certifications affect your choice of services?
